latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.7.1 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Prompt for sign-in when a saved token is revoked by @soconnor0919 in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2386
* Skip Button Dismissable by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2390
* Storable Filters by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2360
* Hide Empty Filters by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2426
* Show PhotoAlbum folders in Folders grouping view by @lzgh0102 in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2432
### Bug Fixes 🛠
* Virtual folder grouping by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2420
* 1.7 tvOS Cleanup by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2421
* Move file image preparation off the main actor by @ivan-magda in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2368
* tvOS Various Fixes by @JPKribs in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2425
### Other ⚙️
* Update formatting by @LePips in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2424
* [iOS] VoiceOver support in the video player by @zoli211 in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2258

## New Contributors
* @soconnor0919 made their first contribution in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2386
* @ivan-magda made their first contribution in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2368
* @zoli211 made their first contribution in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2258
* @lzgh0102 made their first contribution in https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/pull/2432

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/compare/1.7.0...1.7.1

detail.readme:
Swiftfin

Swiftfin is a modern video client for the Jellyfin media server.

## ⚡️ Download ## 🛠️ TestFlight Use the TestFlight version to test new features and bug fixes before being published to the App Store. We are grateful for your time and resources for reporting new bugs. ## 📖 Documentation Swiftfin provides detailed documentation to help you understand key aspects of the app and its development approach: - [🎞️ Library Support](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/libraries.md) — Information on library compatibility and supported media types in Swiftin. - [🎬 Media Playback](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/players.md) — Learn about Swiftfin's playback. - [🧩 OS Version Support](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/version.md) — Read about how we determine the minimum supported OS and which versions of iOS & tvOS are supported. - [🐞 Common Issues](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/common_issues.md) — If you are experiencing an issue with Swiftfin, this is the best place to start. - [💜 Supporting Development](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/contributing/direct-donations) — Learn how you can support project development. ## ⚙️ Development Thank you for your interest in Swiftfin! Please check out the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/jellyfin/Swiftfin/blob/main/Documentation/contributing.md) to get started. ## 📚 Translations **Don't see Swiftfin in your language?** Check out our [Weblate instance](https://translate.jellyfin.org/projects/swiftfin/) to help translate Swiftfin and other Jellyfin projects.
